title: Eternal Wish — 23cm Coiled Dragon & Rider Display
descriptionHtml:
One dragon. Three sweeping coils. A complete storm-wrapped scene.

Eternal Wish sends one long green dragon winding through layered white cloud effects, jagged rock peaks, and sharp gold energy accents. The stacked silhouette creates depth from every angle, while a small rider on a golden cloud sits at the center of the action.

Look closer and the display keeps opening up: painted scales, a gold underbelly, branching horns, curling whiskers, individually sculpted claws, and a cloud-covered base that gives the entire piece enough presence to anchor a collector shelf.

Display details

  • Approximately 9.05 in / 23 cm tall
  • Painted PVC construction
  • Single serpentine dragon arranged in three dramatic coils
  • White cloud-effect base with sculpted rocky peaks
  • Gold lightning accents and a small central rider detail
  • Freestanding finished display for a shelf or desk

A complete scene, not just another figure.

Measurements are approximate and supplied by the seller. Customer photos show the finished product in real collections. Minor differences in paint, color, fit, and finish may occur. Intended for display; contains projecting and potentially small components and should be kept away from young children.
